note: Account figures the option screen sizes against (rules v7.6). balance = current account value from the ledger; base = $25,000 plus deposits minus withdrawals; phase = Proving or Pressing; rate = latest 3-month T-bill rate (FRED DTB3) as a fraction; min_score = the lowest score you will trade (10 = High conviction only, which also sizes calls at the High cap; 7 = the plan's Medium tier). The trading session updates this file when the ledger changes.
